$Comment: What each Christmas daily pays: Santa's two (Daily Thieves and Daily Presents) and the helpers' three
(Tomas's Daily Baking, Elsie's Daily Wrapping and Bram's Daily Carrots). Every roll is read on its
own: the first always pays, the second is a chance on top. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100.
Christmas Coins and festival tokens pay through the Currency reward kind; favor rides each daily's own
Rewards, and so does anything one daily pays that the others do not (Elsie's presents, Bram's
snowballs). A companion mod adds rolls with a file naming this table in ContributesTo.
Name: Christmas_Daily_Pay
